groupBrief: Consume only explicitly trusted, effective, exact-head GitHub requested-change reviews as complete bounded fixup scope. Persist once-only review consumption atomically with one subtask; share existing CI/conflict caps and lifecycle. Commented reviews are informational; approvals are durable inspectable as-of observations without merge authority. Preserve backlog-only deletion rejection; cancellation and defensive orphan recovery retain consumption and cap charges. Preserve ORB-677 formal approval, external re-review, admin bypass, and the boundary that Orbit does not merge. No product dispatch until the operator approves the complete contract and breakdown. See .loop/task-breakdown.md for inspection, choices, acceptance details, and proof limits.

openChoices.recommendation: Default-empty repository-scoped numeric GitHub account IDs in orbit.tasks.github_reviewers; Gateway config only, no public input

Latest decisive review per account across all heads by submitted_at/review ID; no commented replacement, dismissal fallback, or cross-account cancellation; durable approval provenance and current/historical/unverified inspection

Complete 1000-review/500-comment/64-KiB bounds; no linked fetch; GitHub edits/dismissal/cancellation never reset consumed scope; preserve API deletion rejection and defensive orphan consumption/cap retention
review:{reviewer_id} cap identity, durable review-ID key, existing shared caps, conflict/CI before feedback, wait on pending/infrastructure CI
Separate allocated Incus proofs using real engine/workspace behavior and fixture-driven GitHub transport sourced from sanitized read-only output; disclose transport limitations, no live writes

tasks.title: Consume each review once through the settling scheduler
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** Deliver one recoverable checked fixup on the same PR per eligible review, with no duplicate work or increased repair budget.

**Contract:** ADR 0194 consumption/re-review; Tasks #consume-once-and-recover and #review-fixup-lifecycle; existing fixup guards.

**Builds on:** Fresh trusted source, durable approval observations, and complete fixup plans.

**Deliverables:** Unique durable ledger/atomic append, scheduler lifecycle/recovery, isolated assistance, concurrency/caps/CI regression matrix, Gateway checks.

**Acceptance:** See task 6 in .loop/task-breakdown.md for the complete matrix. Persist/refresh the observation report even without a repair, and never let approval trigger lifecycle actions. Verify before/after-commit crashes and concurrent ticks, no external calls under locks, local status/cap recheck, lost start/stranded todo, retry same work on workspace/check/review/push failure, cancellation/GitHub edits/dismissal/renames/head changes/operator resets never duplicate consumption. Cancellation retains rows/charges; deletion outside backlog returns HTTP 409 tasks.not_in_backlog. Defensive missing-row cleanup retains consumption and creation-window cap charges, without double-counting extant tasks or recreating work. Authorized todo edits remain human overrides without changing the ledger or resetting caps/consumption. Conflict then genuine CI then feedback; capped identities may be skipped; shared 2-per-reviewer/3-total caps, pending/infrastructure waits, unchanged-head/no-change guards. Review failures back off then ask and clear only their own cause without disabling CI/conflict or unrelated assistance. Closed/merged state prevents new work/unsafe push. Push returns to settling; external re-review is required, with no GitHub write or Gateway merge. Complete all runtime behavior here; proofs/generators do not fill gaps.

deliverables.description: Unique durable group/repository/PR/review key and packet/digest linked atomically to one fixup; cancellation retains rows/charges; API deletion is rejected outside backlog; defensive orphan handling retains consumption and creation-window cap charge
One recoverable checked fixup on the same branch/PR, existing lifecycle/guards, no repeat consumption or review/merge writes
Crash/start/push recovery, review-read backoff, immediate deterministic assistance, and source-specific recovery preserve other work
Deduplication, transactional race, failure, shared caps, CI/conflict ordering, and external re-review matrix passes
Gateway affected tests and quality checks pass
